downloads.intro: Optional native wrappers for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android. They open librecorsa.org directly, so game updates arrive without reinstalling.

desktop.label: Desktop
desktop.text: Requests the discrete GPU on multi-GPU laptops, grants WebHID silently for racing wheels and DualSense, disables background throttling, and checks GitHub Releases for updates.

android.label: Android
android.text: Fullscreen Trusted Web Activity with no browser URL bar, sticky-immersive edge swipes, Android Game Mode, and Drive / Boards launcher shortcuts.

current.label: Always current
current.text: Every wrapper opens librecorsa.org directly instead of bundling tracks or cars, so physics, circuits and multiplayer updates arrive immediately.

browser.label: Browser & iOS
browser.text: Nothing to install if you prefer playing straight in a tab. On iPhone and iPad, use Safari''s Share > Add to Home Screen.

downloads.builds: All installers and APKs are built from this repository’s source by GitHub Actions and published on GitHub Releases with SHA-256 digests. Free Windows code signing through SignPath Foundation is being set up; macOS builds are currently unsigned; the Android APK is signed with the upload key verified by {file}.
